summary: FS KKR Capital Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $150 million sale of 6 million shares of Cumulative Convertible Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series A, at $25 per share, to KKR Alternative Assets L.P. under a previously disclosed purchase agreement. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including share repurchases or debt repayment. A related registration rights agreement was also entered into. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation; it lacks the transformative or event-driven characteristics typical of acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or other listed categories.
